SecuVidyra Academy

GRC and ISO 27001 Fundamentals

For IT staff and aspiring security-compliance analysts.
8 weeks: 32 live hours + 24 guided practice hours
Outcome: demonstrate skills through lab evidence and an individual submission.

Proposed schedule. Dates, fees and mode to be confirmed.

Learning modules:

Governance, risk and compliance

Governance establishes direction and accountability.
Risk management supports decisions under uncertainty.
Compliance tracks applicable obligations.



ISMS scope and context

Define organisational and technical boundaries.
Identify relevant interested parties and requirements.
Record dependencies and exclusions with reasons.



Assets and ownership

Identify information and supporting systems.
Assign owners who can make decisions.
Classify information by business need.



Risk assessment method

Define likelihood and impact criteria before scoring.
Describe asset, threat, weakness and consequence.
Apply the same criteria consistently.



Risk treatment and acceptance

Choose treatment based on risk and obligations.
Assign an owner, due date and evidence.
Obtain authorised acceptance of remaining risk.



Statement of Applicability

Connect necessary controls to risk treatment.
Record inclusion and exclusion reasoning.
Track implementation status and evidence.



Policies and operating procedures

Policies state direction and responsibilities.
Procedures explain how work happens.
Records show that the work occurred.



Access and supplier controls

Review permissions against business need.
Remove access promptly when roles change.
Assess supplier access and responsibilities.



Evidence quality

Evidence should match scope, date and control.
Check source, completeness and approval.
Limit access to sensitive records.



Internal audit planning

Set scope, criteria and sampling approach.
Select auditors with appropriate objectivity.
Record interviews, observations and evidence.



Findings and corrective action

Link each finding to a requirement and evidence.
Separate correction from root-cause action.
Verify whether the action prevents recurrence.



Management review and measures

Leadership reviews performance and significant changes.
Use measures with clear owners and definitions.
Record decisions and follow-up actions.



Implementation and certification

An organisation implements its ISMS.
An independent certification body assesses certification.
Training completion does not confer auditor accreditation.



Continual improvement

Track incidents, audit findings and changes.
Review whether controls work in practice.
Update risk treatment and accountable actions.



Capstone

Build a miniature ISMS pack for the fictional SaaS company.
Submit scope, five risks, a treatment plan and a sample SoA.
Include an audit checklist, one finding and a corrective-action record.

Implementation education only. Not an accredited Lead Auditor qualification or authority to issue ISO certificates.

Academy completion certificate only. No employment guarantee.
